page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed systems. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a high-density allocation of dedicated compute and memory resources within a single virtualized environment, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances for large-scale workloads.

Given its balanced resource profile of 128 vCPUs and 512 GB of RAM, the ecs.g7.32xlarge is designed for enterprise-grade applications, large-scale web serving, middle-tier application servers, and containerized microservices. It is also suitable for running medium-sized databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and build systems that require substantial parallel processing capabilities without specialized GPU acceleration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, running on Intel Xeon 8369B processors at 2.7 GHz under the KVM hypervisor. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, it maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not feature local storage, relying instead on external storage solutions, but it delivers a high baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. This resource profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for high-density deployments by consolidating workloads onto a single large node. The ecs.g7.32xlarge is optimized for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, container orchestration, and database workloads that require high parallel processing power and substantial memory capacity without the need for dedicated GPU hardware.
